Identification of the face is therefore printed rather than inferred. The archive records Eddie Smith in Congress in 1988-89, as a Judicial Council member and Treasurer through 1990-91, and the board's 'Senior' in 1989-90 puts his first semester in autumn 1986, which is where the existing Talisman freshman cell comes from. Filed to 1989-90, a year the archive records him in.

name: Dan Knowles
why: An upgrade on quality rather than on pixel count. He currently carries a 527 by 620 crop from the front page of the Herald of 2 April 1991 in which the halftone has broken up so badly that the face is a field of blotches with the eyes and mouth barely readable. This is 370 by 410 and it is a clean printed studio portrait: the 1989-90 class composite board at stu_org/321 p. 4, where 'Dan Knowles / Kevil, KY / Sophomore, Corporate & Organizational Communications' is set directly beneath his own photograph on a card cut from the printed brochure and mounted separately, so the name and the face are one printed unit. Years agree: the board is 1989-90 and calls him a sophomore, which puts his first semester in autumn 1988, the year the archive first records him in Congress; it also has him as Lobby Coordinator in 1990-91, which is when the Herald photographed him. Filed to 1988-89 where the existing crop sits, under a new filename so nothing is overwritten.
